owner_gate: Production restart/cutover of router-proxy services on :9092 and :9391, then one live tick under ROUTER_DEGRADED_WALL_S.
verification_command: curl -sS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:9092/health; curl -sS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:9391/health; ps -eo pid,lstart,args | grep -E '[r]outer_server.py.*(--port 9092|--port 9391)'; uptime; free -h; ss -ltnp '( sport = :9092 or sport = :9391 )'
